title: Repair truthful GMGN retry request bound
objective: Repair the failed independent audit finding by making the bounded daily report truthfully account for the pinned gmgn-cli@1.5.4 rate-limit retry path. Keep one fixed GMGN discovery invocation, but declare and test a maximum of two underlying GMGN HTTP attempts, while preserving all existing Solana-only, read-only, sanitization, candidate-count, market-cap, age, Helius request and persistence boundaries.
forbidden_actions: Do not change the fixed GMGN discovery command, candidate eligibility rules, provider selection or pinned gmgn-cli version.
Do not add another provider, chain, discovery query, background loop, database, cache, queue, address library or trading capability.
Do not call GMGN or Helius and do not inspect or display credential values.
Do not retain or emit raw provider payloads, arbitrary provider text, full exception text, API keys or credential-bearing URLs.
Do not change the Helius request budget or reinterpret GMGN claims as independently verified facts.
Do not write outside the exact repair write set.
